title: pro integral derived unit
statement: Let n>0, R=ULift(Z/n), A a commutative ring killed by n, i:D→Z a closed immersion and φ:R→A. If Cartier classes cR,cA satisfy GeoCartierScalarCompatibility [sk-lem-geo-cartier], then the pro-etale supported integral generator i_*Z_D→forget(i_*A_D) is a degree-zero unbounded scalar unit [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data, def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Use the supported pro-etale residue quotient unit. Extract from coefficient compatibility the derived unit on supported constants for extension R→A. Compose the ordinary derived-unit Hom bijections. Composite coefficient forgetting is definitionally direct forgetting, so change the unit predicate along that definitional equality. The normalized supported integral scalar identity identifies the composite map with the stated integral generator. Finally the zero-shift comparison identifies its ordinary unit property with the degree-zero Ext-unit property.

lean.statement:
theorem pro_integral_derived_unit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hA : (n : A) = 0) (hR : (n : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) = 0)
    {D Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (φ : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n) →+* A)
    (cR : GeoCartierClass (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)) n hR i)
    (cA : GeoCartierClass A n hA i)
    (hcompat : GeoCartierScalarCompatibility φ n hR hA i cR cA) :
    CartierScalarUnit (cartierForget A Z)
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology D) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))))
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (geoCartierConstant A D)) 0
      (Ext.mk₀.{u + 1} (cartierProIntegralGenerator A i))
